concerns.text: FR-018 (obtain a verified joint SMILES + FQY dataset) is not linked to any Success Criterion. No SC currently measures or validates that the dataset contains both SMILES strings and experimental fluorescence quantum yield values. Add a Success Criterion (e.g., SC-009) that verifies the joint nature of the dataset, such as: "The pipeline must confirm that every record in the downloaded dataset includes both a valid SMILES string and a corresponding FQY value, and the count of such complete records is reported in the final log." This will anchor FR-018 and close the orphaned requirement.
